purpose: Audit radiation specificity, preprocessing transport and matched-control response modeling
development: All run06 studies are now development data; do not relabel them independent confirmation
new_challenge: GSE111437 RNA-seq IMR90 2Gy 6h and 24h versus time-matched controls, all eligible profiles; select by metadata and source availability only
variants: run06 source processing on matched available subset
NCBI gene counts for both studies, common pinned exon lengths and gene universe
training_targets: IR vs all normal-IMR90 negatives including nonradiation stresses
model: VarianceThreshold 1e-12; train StandardScaler; L2 LogisticRegression C1 liblinear seed17; fixed zero-logit threshold; no hyperparameter search
reference_variant: Train in feature differences from matched control mean, leave each training control out of its own reference; test requires disjoint known controls, enumerate every choice of 2 reference controls and evaluate remaining controls plus treatments. References never scored as test samples. No external treatment labels used in model fitting. Report all variants, no outcome-selected winner.
